display.title: Capstone: The End Compass
display.subtitle: Forged from Deep Aether
description: The Eye of Ender will not serve you here. To even target the End portal,
you must first work Tier 4's first dimension - the Deep Aether - and forge
an End Compass from its materials.
The End Compass points the way to an End Bastion: the gateway structure
that anchors the stronghold search. The End is genuinely POST-Deep-Aether.
